name: AI Deep Dive — NVDA — 2026-02-15
rationale: NVIDIA remains the undisputed king of the AI infrastructure buildout (Rule of 40 score: 128.51), with Data Center revenue exploding >100% YoY. While 60%+ net margins are likely peak and will compress as competition (AMD, custom ASICs) arrives, the sheer backlog for Blackwell/Rubin chips supports a strong 3-year wide-moat thesis. However, valuation at $4.5T market cap demands flawless execution; any cyclic slowdown or margin compression could trigger a significant correction.

bear.rationale: Competition from hyperscaler custom silicon checks pricing power. Margins compress from 55% to 45% as supply glut emerges in 2027. AI capex cycle slows down.

base.rationale: Sustained AI infrastructure boom through 2028. Blackwell ramp succeeds. Margins normalize slightly to 50% but volume compensates. Dominance in inference training holds.

bull.rationale: Sovereign AI and physical AI (robotics) drive a second supercycle. Margins hold at record levels due to software/services mix shift (NIMs). $10T+ market cap potential.

aiThesis.rationale: NVDA is priced for perfection but executing perfectly. The raw financial strength (Rule of 40 > 120, Piotroski 8/9) confirms fundamental health. The main risk is cyclicality of capex, not competitive displacement in the near term. Base case targets $320+ by 2030, offering solid upside even from $180 levels.
